Circular 
Department: FUTURES & OPTIONS 
Download Ref No: NSE/FAOP/76899 Date: October 14, 2026 
Circular Ref. No: 140/2026  
 
All Members, 
 
Introduction of Futures & Options Contracts on Six Individual Securities 
 
Members are advised to note that based on the stock selection criteria as prescribed by SEBI vide  master 
circular no. SEBI/HO/MRD-PoD2/CIR/P/2024/00181 dated December 30, 2024 and approval received from 
SEBI, members are hereby notified that the futures and options contracts on following securities would be 
available for trading w.e.f. October 28, 2026,  subject to fulfilment of eligibility criteria of Quarter sigma 
computation cycle of October 2026. 
 
Sr. No. Symbol Security Name 
1 COROMANDEL Coromandel International Limited 
2 CUB City Union Bank Limited 
3 DATAPATTNS Data Patterns (India) Limited 
4 KARURVYSYA Karur Vysya Bank Limited 
5 NAVINFLUOR Navin Fluorine International Limited 
6 SYRMA Syrma SGS Technology Limited 
 
Other Important Points to be noted: 
• The market lot and scheme of strikes of the above mentioned securities shall be informed to members 
on October 27, 2026 through a separate circular. 
• The details of applicable quantity freeze shall be available in the contract file which shall be applicable 
for trading on October 28, 2026.  
• Members are advised to load the updated contract.gz and NSE_FO_contract_ddmmyyyy.csv.gz file in 
the trading application before trading on the effective date. This file can be obtained from the directory 
faoftp/faocommon on the Extranet server. Additionally, members can access the MII contract file -  
NSE_FO_contract_ddmmyyyy.csv.gz on the website path: - https://www.nseindia.com/all-reports-
derivatives.
